name: Code Tools
description: File read/write/edit, glob, grep, ls, and shell tools for local code interaction

workspaceRoot.label: Workspace Root
workspaceRoot.help: Root directory for file operations. All paths are resolved relative to this.

maxFileSizeBytes.label: Max File Size
maxFileSizeBytes.help: Maximum file size in bytes for read operations (1024-50000000)

shellTimeout.label: Shell Timeout
shellTimeout.help: Maximum execution time in milliseconds for shell commands (1000-600000)

maxGlobResults.label: Max Glob Results
maxGlobResults.help: Maximum number of glob results returned (10-5000)

maxGrepResults.label: Max Grep Results
maxGrepResults.help: Maximum number of grep results returned (1-500)

shellEnabled.label: Shell Enabled
shellEnabled.help: Whether shell command execution is allowed
